newsitem.title: JAPAN: More than 40 vehicles in Japan motorway pileups.
newsitem.headline: More than 40 vehicles in Japan motorway pileups.

text.p: More than 40 cars and trucks crashed into each other in a series of motorway pileups caused by heavy snow in central Japan on Monday, a police spokesman said.
The spokesman said at least 13 people were injured in the accidents, which happened at the end of a week-long holiday in Japan.

"It's an unheard of incident in these parts...There are over forty vehicles including trucks involved in around 10 different crashes...and we're still counting," Motorway Transport Police spokesman Ikuyu Furata told Reuters.
The pileups occured at and near the Otsuki Interchange, 70 km (40 miles) west of Tokyo.
"The collisions were due to heavy snow...we cleared the snow from the road earlier but there was still some on the surface," Furuta said.
